display.purpose: Hero slides only: onboarding intro/outro. Never used for interactive labels or body text.

headline.purpose: Section headers inside expanded pages. Feature names in onboarding carousel.

title.purpose: Time display, primary data values. JetBrains Mono Black makes numbers read as instruments.

body.purpose: Notification text, music track titles, page content.

label.purpose: Dates, timestamps, source names, app labels. Uppercase tracking for notification category labels only.

shadows.name: elev1-signal-lift
shadows.purpose: Minibubbles and interactive chips. Separates from base without announcing.

shadows.name: elev2-surface-float
shadows.purpose: Expanded popups, sheets, island expanded state.

shadows.name: elev3-hero-depth
shadows.purpose: Album art, lock screen surface, modal-level content.

shadows.name: halo-primary
shadows.purpose: Primary minibubble breathing halo. Only animated shadow in the system.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Background color shifts, icon swaps, immediate feedback.

motion.name: dur-exit
motion.purpose: Island collapse, page exit. Exits are faster than entrances.

motion.name: dur-tracking
motion.purpose: Bubble repositioning (OutExpo). Must stay ahead of island edge change.

motion.name: dur-halo
motion.purpose: Primary bubble halo and scale morph (InOutCubic). Breathes, not snaps.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: easeOutCubic — default for all state transitions.

motion.name: ease-breathe
motion.purpose: InOutCubic — halo and primary scale. Symmetric morph.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Universal press feedback scale. Applied to all tappable surfaces.

components.name: Island Pill (Solid)
components.description: The collapsed island container in solid theme mode.
components.css: .ds-island-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #181825; border-radius: 28px; padding: 6px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(205,214,244,0.12); min-height: 36px; } .ds-island-time { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-island-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: rgba(205,214,244,0.10); } .ds-island-weather { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #fab387; }

components.name: Island Pill (Glass)
components.description: The collapsed island container in glass theme mode — compositor blur with white tint.
components.css: .ds-island-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-radius: 28px; padding: 6px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); min-height: 36px; } .ds-island-time-glass { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #cdd6f4; }

components.name: Minibubble
components.description: Floating status pill. Primary variant has halo shadow and full scale; satellite is 82% scale, no halo.
components.css: .ds-bubble { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #313244; border-radius: 28px; padding: 6px 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), box-shadow 480ms cubic-bezier(0.445,0.05,0.55,0.95); } .ds-bubble--primary { transform: scale(1.0); box-shadow: 0 5px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-bubble--satellite { transform: scale(0.82); box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .ds-bubble:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-bubble-icon { font-size: 14px; color: #cba6f7; } .ds-bubble-label { font-family: 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #cdd6f4; }

components.name: Page Action Button

components.html: <button class="ds-page-btn"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><polygon points="5,3 13,8 5,13" fill="#cdd6f4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-page-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #313244; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; min-width: 36px; min-height: 36px; color: #cdd6f4; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1); } .ds-page-btn:hover { background: #45475a; } .ds-page-btn:active { background: #45475a; transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-page-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cba6f7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-page-btn--active { color: #cba6f7; }

components.name: Applet Chip
components.description: Topbar applet in default and active states.
components.css: .ds-applet-chip-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-applet-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #a6adc8; font-family: 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), color 120ms; } .ds-applet-chip:hover { background: #313244; color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-applet-chip:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-applet-chip--active { background: #313244; color: #cba6f7; } .ds-applet-sep { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: rgba(205,214,244,0.10); margin: 0 2px; }

narrative.overview:
ActivSpot is a system that breathes at rest and sharpens on interaction — like a lens that only focuses when you need it to. At its default state, the collapsed island pill is a hairline presence at the top of the screen: a faint capsule shape against whatever wallpaper is beneath it, offering just enough information to be useful without demanding attention. On expansion, it becomes a precise, full-featured surface.

The palette lives in a deep indigo-violet darkness. Not a neutral dark — a tinted one. The Near-Black Indigo base (#1e1e2e) has a deliberate blue-violet cast that separates it from flat grays and keeps every surface in the same color family as the Muted Iris accent. When the accent appears, it reads as an intensification of the background rather than a foreign intrusion.

This system explicitly rejects the utilitarian flatness of generic Waybar setups, the visual clutter of widget-heavy shells, the derivative feel of macOS recreation, and the neon overload of r/unixporn maximalism.
keyCharacteristics: Dark indigo-violet base with accent used sparingly as a signal, not a decoration
Three-font stack: SF Pro Text for prose, JetBrains Mono for data/time/labels, Iosevka Nerd Font for icons
Two surface modes: solid (mantle at full opacity) and glass (compositor blur, 9% white tint)
Apple-grade depth model: large-blur, low-opacity shadows that lift without casting
Motion serves state changes; no choreography for its own sake
All tokens scale with display resolution via a linear s() function at 1920px base

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Muted Iris appears on ≤15% of any surface at rest. When it appears, it means something. Never use it as a container fill or generic highlight.

rules.name: The Hue-Family Rule
rules.body: Every background layer shares the blue-violet hue family. No neutral grays. New surfaces must be tinted toward the violet family, not neutralized.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Every number that represents a measured value uses JetBrains Mono at Black weight. SF Pro Text is for language; Mono is for measurement.

rules.name: The Ambient Rule
rules.body: Shadow is atmosphere, not outline. If a shadow appears to define an edge, the blur radius is too small or the opacity is too high.

rules.name: The Halo Distinction
rules.body: The primary minibubble carries a breathing halo shadow (480ms InOutCubic). This is the only context where a shadow has animation.

dos: Do use Muted Iris exclusively as a signal: active states, focused elements, interactive labels.
Do use JetBrains Mono Black for every numeric value that represents a measurement.
Do keep resting-state surfaces below lifted-plum (#313244).
Do use large-blur, low-opacity shadows (elev tokens). Shadow reads as atmosphere, not border.
Do animate at 120-320ms with easeOutCubic or OutExpo. Press feedback at 92% scale.
Do tint every new surface toward the blue-violet hue family.
Do use the semantic aliases (accent, accentAlt, warning, danger, positive) in new components.
Do treat glass mode as a separate surface contract — tintAlpha 6-9%, compositor blur only.
donts: Don't make Muted Iris a background fill or container color.
Don't use flat neutral grays (e.g. #2a2a2a, #333333 with no hue) in any surface.
Don't recreate macOS Dynamic Island pixel-for-pixel — no derivative shape with no original identity.
Don't add neon or heavily-saturated accent colors outside the 6 defined themes.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any container.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient).
Don't add glassmorphism decoratively — glass mode is a compositor contract, not a QML blur effect.
Don't render the island at lower than radXl (28px) in any state.
Don't introduce a Generic Waybar aesthetic: flat layout, no surface depth, uniform rows.
